name: @devcxl/opencode-cabbage
description: OpenCode 全流程开发插件 — 需求→设计→任务→编码→测试→审查→自动合并，支持自动编排与并行 Subagent。兼容 OpenCode 与 Codex 双平台。

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.test:pack: npm run build && pack_out=$(npm pack --dry-run 2>&1); echo "$pack_out" | grep -q 'dist/kernel/' || { echo 'FAIL: tarball 缺少 dist/kernel/'; exit 1; }; echo "$pack_out" | grep -q 'dist/flowrun/' && { echo 'FAIL: tarball 含过期 flowrun/ 残留'; exit 1; }; for f in '.codex-plugin/plugin.json' 'codex-skills/flow-setup/SKILL.md' 'codex-skills/agent-dev-lifecycle/SKILL.md' 'hooks/hooks.json' 'dist/hooks/session-start.js'; do echo "$pack_out" | grep -q "$f" || { echo "FAIL: tarball 缺少 $f"; exit 1; }; done; echo 'PASS: tarball 含 dist/kernel/ + Codex 插件文件（manifest/skills/hooks/dist-hooks），无 flowrun/ 残留'
